subject: Confusing interaction between reshape and reshape2: melt(data.frame, value.name='a')

messages.author: fc772258f24953a6
messages.subject: Confusing interaction between reshape and reshape2: melt(data.frame, value.name='a')
parts:
I've been using the variable.name and value.name arguments a lot
lately. I think they make code a lot cleaner.
In the past, I've had some issues with both reshape and reshape2 being
loaded and the wrong melt getting used. I've resolved these by
removing the reshape package, but now I'm now using a package that
requires reshape (GGally), so this "simple" solution no longer works.

I figured I'd just make *sure* the correct function gets called using
the reshape2::melt() syntax. I'm getting some strange results that I
don't really understand, though. I can use a full
reshape2:::melt.data.frame() call to get the desired results, but this
seems like the Wrong Way (tm). Any insight would be great. (I have
fresh installs of both packages, R version 3.0.1, ubuntu).

## If I comment out this line, all 3 work fine
require(reshape)
require(reshape2)
##
head(melt(ChickWeight, id=2:4, value.name='a'), 5)
## Doesn't work, no errors, mystery!
head(reshape2::melt(ChickWeight, id=2:4, value.name='a'), 5)
## works
head(reshape2:::melt.data.frame(ChickWeight, id=2:4, value.name='a'), 5)

Thanks,
Christian
